title.label: Very good for people who are NOT data crunchers

content.label: I use Apple Health/Fitness, Withings Health (premium), Hume Health (premium) and Gentler Streak (premium).  I also use Apple Watch 12, Hume Band2.0, Withings Body Comp scale and Hume Pod scale. So for the data junkie in me I look to Hume and Withings but I find polar opposites in recommendations.  Today Hume said rest, low activity, recovery. Withings said Very Ready. Apple said Favorable/Ready.  All gave various metrics and data.  Gentler Streak was a lot easier to understand, skips past the metrics and offers simple written suggestions.  It gives a simple graph that shows your path, cardio health, etc.  it does so my drawing conclusions from your Apple Watch collected data and your scale’s data, collected in Apple Health. I like the simple direction and simple graphics.  If you are NOT a metrics junkie, this is a great app to watch the direction of your health.

title.label: Tired of “AI” being shoved into everything

content.label:
I’m giving Gentler a grace period since I saw you tell another reviewer that your “AI” features are on-device Apple Intelligence (which was forced on us all like it or not) and optional, but you’re on notice. “AI” in its current form is a destructive technology that was released into the public many years before it was ready to be out of a purely research environment. Data centers are poisoning the water, electricity bills, and sound levels of the communities forced to host them. And generative “AI” only exists because it was trained off of work stolen from human artists. Not to mention the financial sleight of hand maintaining this nonsense, dragging us all towards a bubble that needs to pop sooner rather than later.

Tread carefully. And I better not see even a hint of a genAI Yorhart!

Gentler Streak provides me with better exercise and health information than any other app I have subscribed to. It helps me to make informed decisions and I love the health items that it tracks! Five stars all the way!!!!

Finally an exercise app that fits what I want to do, which is walk use rowing machine and ride a bike. Very easy to set up you 
do not have to jump through hoops to eliminate things that you do not need.

I’ve had this app for years. In the early days it worked well. But not so much any more. New features get bolted on while bugs accumulate.

If your Apple Watch should run out of battery while in use, the app gets terribly confused and stuck. 

I spent the last year with the Watch complication saying “Getting to know”. I’ve no idea what it wants to learn nor how to teach it.

This month my green thermometer streak meter will appear one day at the top, on the verge of “overreaching”. Next day the streak meter is at the bottom of the green, implying little activity. Today it got worse, declaring my “streak is lost” with my streak meter dropped dead into the red. Meanwhile my actual activity, mainly dog walks, has been the same two to three walks a day, everyday. 

Apparently I’ve been paying for them to add superfluous features I’ll never use, while bugs accumulate in the very core of their basic functionality. So I’ll be ending my subscription, instead relying on Apple’s built-in improving exercise tracking and health advising features.
Not interested in AI so I'm deleting

I’ve been using this app since it debuted. I am an endurance athlete. It gives me everything I need in a snap! Plus it’s adorable and independently owned. I recommend this app over any other fitness app!

Only tracks sleep and half the steps and no calories. It’s unusable for the most part. Try adding exercise and it does allow it. Terrible usability. A complete waste of money. I wish I could get my money and  expectations back.
It’s a good app to let you know if you overtrained or can push a little more.
I guess maybe the app isn’t intuitive, at least not for me. I might as well just fill in a spreadsheet.

If you could make it so your data could get synced through iCloud, to your watch like what you should do today, or if your pushing too hard so you don’t need to carry around a phone. it would really improve your app.
I hade this app for a  month I want it longer but every 5 seconds there was a add

It’s very frustrating that menstruation data requires a subscription. This is just another example of the pink tax that functionally affects HALF of the population!
I’m sure the app is great but it doesn’t sit right that data only affecting people who menstruate is hidden behind a paywall.

Gentler Streak is a core (yet unobtrusive) part of my day to day. The flexibility of the Activity Path and the encouragement of rest days helped me form good habits without feeling all-or-nothing. Gentler Streak helped me ease into an active lifestyle again after coming out on the other side of years of debilitating illnesses and not only helped me establish my new normal but provided me the tools of how to work with my body without making me feel like missing “progress” days was a setback. I can’t recommend Gentler Streak enough, especially for those who struggle with the rigidity of an all-or-nothing approach or those who wish to understand how the rhythms of their body impact fitness/activity goals.

My main form of workouts is doing strength training. And I’m consistently pushing and progressing. But the app basically doesn’t recognize the benefit of anything other than doing cardio. Just got a message that I should bump up my activity. Mind you I’ve done 2 60+ minute hard lifting sessions this week with 10 minute Metcon work after. A bit annoying that all the app cares about is long cardio sessions. Could be a good app for motivation but that’s a really annoying way of looking at fitness. Might uninstall

That has wonderful features, but they’re all duplicated from the APPLE Health app. Apple health app is more businesslike, but it seems you can see the data more coherently in the APPLE Health app.

The Gentler Streak workout tracker is fine, but it’s kind of childish presents the information and it’s all over the place you dig into it to see the information it’s not presented in a logical fashion at least to me I could be wrong.

I’ve had the app for a little over a month or maybe less than a month. I’m not sure but I have put in a request for a refund. That is great maybe for others but for me I found it a little too hard to find information readily.
It’s cute, but language is annoying. Mostly it does not write data to apple fitness about energy, just time, unless you have an Apple Watch.

I wanted to like this app. I even gave it several days to accumulate my health data. Then I realized it’s just a cash grab. Once your data populates, it’s instantly hidden behind a paywall and you get bombarded with adds to upgrade to a subscription. There is nothing “freemium” about Gentler Streak! It’s just an attempt to get installed on your phone so it can pester you with subscription offers. All the data is useless because they won’t let you see it until you pay. I wish I could see what the app is like without all the paywalls, so I could decide if it’s worth paying for!?!? But no, you have to sign up for a subscription (and it auto renews if you don’t remember to cancel the “free” trial).  Hard pass.
Abundante, exitosa,bendecida ❤️ atraigo siempre cosas buenas

name.label: Heads I win, Tails you lose

title.label: App works, but lies about real fitness levels

content.label: The app works. However, it tells me that I have to keep taking 3 day breaks. I’m a healthy persons with no issues, but when I do a workout, like a 30 min easy walk, it complains that I am overreaching and demands I take three days off. That’s not healthy…that’s messed up. If the heart rate stays below 110, it’s safe to walk everyday, but this app feels differently. I’m thinking of canceling my subscription because I refuse to pay for a service that is basically lying to me.

title.label: So far a waste of money

content.label: It keeps promising to reveal something special eventually. 12 days in and there is nothing that I could not see on the Apple Health App.

It tells you the same things over and over and over. It does not track accurately one minute to tell you that you’re over exceeding, then the next day you need to work out like you’ve never worked out in your entire life.  It use to be better, but with all the “upgrades” it has become awful.  I have had this app for several years and I am now going to get rid of it.
Supports Bluesky but not X...? I guess that's good for the six or so people on Bluesky. Hopefully this is not some sort of political decision. You shouldn't punish your users for politics.
Gentler Streak Workout Tracker

At first glance, this appears to be a good app to summarize activities. Unfortunately, I quickly found out that you are unable to edit or delete activities that may be duplicates or other related options. I also noticed that there’s no place for putting in your weight?!? They have age and height as part of your metrics, why not weight? As such, cancelled my subscription within a week - what a waste of money!

title.label: Don’t know what this is for or about, but would like to cancel or stopped!

content.label: Thanks

So much praise for the Customer Support team; they were SO responsive to my question and I see how consistent that is across all their community platforms. 💕 I’m also loving the adjustable suggestions for active recovery - great visual for understanding balance in movement and rest.

Update: did an outdoor walk with sound turned on in settings and everything work. No lock ups.
Thank you very much. Great App.

title.label: No way to see if this is the right fit for you without paying up front

content.label: Be weary of apps like this that don’t let you test a premium version with a trial. This app wants your money up front so you can’t see if it’s a good fit without giving them money up front. And you only receive the 50% off discount for 24 hours after downloading the app. I primarily use iPhone widgets and my Apple Watch complications for viewing my data at a glance. I can’t test the accuracy of this app without premium off the bat. Don’t waste your money on a chance to see if this works for you.

This app has been so handy and useful since I have downloaded it. It told me the day that I pushed myself too hard, and I felt that in my body. I’ve learned how to listen to my body and take rest days when needed because of Gentler Streak.
It’s one of my favorite apps, I like it. The only is the sub’s price is too expensive 🥹

The most positive thing about Gentler Streak is that I make the choice to use Gentler Streak because I spend my day doing different types of exercises from not long after I wake up in the morning, until I go to bed at night. And it allows me to record them because it has a good selection of different types of workouts. And syncs with my Apple Watch & iPhone. 

Basically, the most important thing I'm asking for is that rather than having to touch the "HOLD TO END" button, being able to just be able to scroll over to view a screen to switch over to ANOTHER workout without stopping!

And sadly the negative thing about Gentler Streak is that it doesn't do well outside of my home. So as soon as I leave the house I have to switch over to using Apple Fitness Tracker instead. The first reason is that if I am using Gentler to record my "Daily Chores", working on some of them as my Wonderful Hubby is driving me somewhere, Gentler Streak will first send me a message that I'm not active! If I don't look at my watch to see the message it will stop my "Daily Chores"!

If they haven't been stopped, and we're getting ready to arrive where I'm going to get out and walk, I can't wait until we actually arrive there! Because after I push the "HOLD TO END" it takes a very long time before it actually stops! And lets me start my "Walking-Indoor"! My Wonderful Hubby doesn't want to stand there & wait for me to start walking! So I've been using my Fitness Tracker for anything done outside of the home. Unless we go to a hotel. I start using Gentler Streak inside the hotel.
There is no way to say that you have had surgery so of course it affects your daily exercise etc
Bought the membership and was unhappy with the product. Unsubscribed and instantly lost access to the app while still paying for the year.

title.label: One year review of Gentler Streak

content.label: The app continues to be essential for me.  It provides tracking & monitoring of activities. The advice is on point; gentle—yes and a motivator.  I will renew and maybe even upgrade to Premium.

I do want to love the app, I truly do. I am so puzzled by very obvious issues

1. The app on the watch doesn’t does not lock when you swim. I just finished swimming and paused the workout by pushing side buttons, got home and what a surprise! the time and laps were back on, so the whole workout is totally ruined. Default apple app works flawlessly.

2. Watch compilation sometimes does not update for days. Even reinstall did not fix it. What’s the point?

This app has made a huge difference in my own self care. While Apple’s rings feel like high pressure and lead to feelings of failure, Gentler Streaks feels encouraging and keeps me exercising. 

The only problem is a complete lack of Shortcuts support. It would double my usage of the app if I could trigger workout recording or more easily add standard workouts that I didn’t record live. Even the simplest Shortcuts would help. Thanks!
Fantastic app. One of the few apps that I open and use daily, and even out a widget on my Home Screen. My life and activity have improved by using this app.
Game changer! Incorporating rest and suggesting both tough and easier workouts takes the guess work out. And the graphics! Adorable.
Gracias muy excelente para  saber de la salud
Aggregating sleep, step count, workout and key biometric markers provides a dashboard for sustainable activity with snapshots of readiness and progress daily. Outstanding!

I know I shouldn’t need the app to validate that I need rest, but it really does help me back off when I am torn between pushing too hard and resting.  I also love the fitness path so that I can gauge the potential impact of my actions.
I’ve been using Gentler Streak for several years but really is all it’s hyped to be.  The activity path really is a motivator!
The app is filled with features that are very useful. For those who are on a health journey it’s definitely worth checking it out and definitely recommend.
Gentler Streaks is an excellent app. Works great with Apple Watch

I am motivated by positivity so this is the first app I open every morning to check out my sleep metrics and workout suggestions.  I LOVE that this app always encourages balance and self-awareness above just pushing through to some arbitrary goal.

I’m a psychologist who preaches healthy habit forming so it’s exciting to see an app that supports moving with compassion. I love that the developers use concepts from behavioral science! Great work!!

Love the activity path graphic which helps me modulate my exercise and fitness activities. Not always go for more but find a balance with time to rest and recoup based on past days and sleep and vitals. Well done

I use this in conjunction with Apple Fitness to “gently” guide my activity and exercise goals. At almost 66 years old it’s nice to have the data and the suggestions to keep me from overdoing some days and not doing it at all on others. I am really enjoying it.
